summary: Braskem SA files a management proposal for an extraordinary general meeting on June 8, 2026, regarding a judicial share purchase agreement where Novonor and NSP Investimentos sell approximately 50.11% of common shares and 13.71% of Class A preferred shares (34.32% of total capital) to FIP Shine I, advised by IG4. A new shareholders' agreement with Petrobras establishes balanced governance with equal board representation. The filing is a 6-K, equivalent to a US Form 8-K, disclosing a change-of-control transaction. Key conditions include judicial authorizations and other precedent conditions. Watch for regulatory approvals and shareholder meeting outcome.
